# Play — Are We There Yet?

- SudokuPad: [Are We There Yet? on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Are We There Yet? on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Odometers are an invented rule, so no app knows them. Each one is exported as a cosmetic thin blue line from its circle,
with a circle on the start cell (no arrowhead in the apps; the end away from the circle is the tip). No app will enforce
the distance rule: the rules text is the authority. SudokuPad still checks your finished grid against the embedded
solution. I have not opened the links in a browser myself.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
